description: This file defines the AWS LicenseManagerUserSubscriptionsClient class, which extends AwsClient and facilitates interactions with the AWS License Manager User Subscriptions service. It includes method annotations for various service operations such as associating users, managing license server endpoints, listing resources, and handling product subscriptions.

classes.name: LicenseManagerUserSubscriptionsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS License Manager User Subscriptions, providing methods for managing user subscriptions, license endpoints, identity providers, and related resources.

methods.name: associateUser
methods.description: Associates a user with the License Manager.

methods.name: associateUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a user with the License Manager.

methods.name: createLicenseServerEndpointAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a license server endpoint.

methods.name: deleteLicenseServerEndpointAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a license server endpoint.

methods.name: disassociateUser
methods.description: Disassociates a user from the License Manager.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateIdentityProviderSettings
methods.description: Updates the settings for an identity provider.
